title: Mean Distance
description: Essential Criteria: The mean distance traveled by the pions before they decay must be correctly calculated as 11.2 km.

title: Maximum Angle
description: Essential Criteria: The maximum angle of the muons relative to the pion direction must be correctly calculated as 0.0112 degrees.

title: Neutrino Momenta
description: Essential Criteria: The minimum and maximum momenta of the neutrinos must be correctly calculated as 1.04 x 10^-2 MeV/c and 8.54 x 10^4 MeV/c respectively.

title: Time Dilation
description: Important Criteria: The application of time dilation to find the laboratory lifetime of the pion must be correctly shown.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The use of conservation of energy in the decay process must be correctly applied to find the energy of the muon.

title: Momentum Transformation
description: Important Criteria: The transformation of momentum from the pion rest frame to the laboratory frame must be correctly addressed.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units must be consistent and correctly converted where necessary.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes in momentum calculations must be avoided.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing factors in the energy or momentum calculations must be checked to avoid incorrect results.
